start: A routine whose bench press has 3 normal sets, opened in the routine editor

user_sees: Stepper shows 2; the 'Sets' stepper still shows 3
must_not: Working sets changed by the warm-up stepper
A different rep range from the one the Target uses

user_sees: Two warm-up rows then three working rows
must_not: Warm-up weights changed by the app
Warm-ups counted in records or volume as working sets

start: A workout from a routine where the member marked one set as drop and one as failure

steps.action: Finish and choose to update the routine
user_sees: The routine page shows '... 3 sets · 1 drop · 1 to failure'
must_not: Set types changed in the routine when the member did not change them
Per-set target reps or weights of kept sets lost

start: A Hevy routine or a routine file with per-set targets and timed sets ('Plank 3 × 60 s')

user_sees: Preview lines like '2 warm-up · 3 sets · 1 drop'
The routine page shows each set's target reps, weight or time
must_not: A timed hold given a made-up rep range
A planned weight shown in the wrong unit's plates

user_sees: '13 sets?' 'That is more sets than most routines use.' with 'Keep 13 sets'
must_not: 13 saved when the member says no

steps.action: Try to go below 1 set or above 10 warm-ups
user_sees: The stepper stops at 1 set and at 10 warm-ups

steps.action: Open a file whose set list is damaged
user_sees: The row reads as plain normal sets
must_not: A crash or an empty exercise

start: Routine with 2 warm-ups, 3 sets and 1 drop set

user_sees: 2 sets kept with the warm-ups; the drop set after the removed last set goes
must_not: The old 3 sets coming back after the next warm-up change

steps.action: Share or back up the routine
user_sees: Set types and targets travel with the routine
must_not: Set targets shared with anyone the member did not send it to
